current_transaction_data_flow.amount_storage: minor units in integer cents / BigInt
current_transaction_data_flow.request_metadata: correlationId and requestId propagated by controller when present in request headers
current_transaction_data_flow.sensitive_data_policy: No passwords, tokens, or full request bodies are logged by default

identified_risks: Amount validation relied on integer checks but did not explicitly reject malformed numeric representations before conversion.
The transaction flow did not carry structured request metadata into the audit trail for create/update operations.
Scale anomalies such as exact x100 / x1/100 patterns were not explicitly surfaced as signals without mutating the record.
changes_made: Added strict integer-cent normalization in the transaction service before persistence.
Rejected decimal values, NaN, Infinity, and malformed numeric strings before writing to the repository.
Attached correlationId and requestId to transaction audit metadata when available.
Added AMOUNT_SCALE_ANOMALY detection that emits a signal without altering the transaction record.
Ensured finance-bot evaluation failures do not break transaction creation flow.
security_considerations: No secrets are stored in audit metadata.
Request tracing intentionally excludes authorization headers and sensitive personal data.
Amount values are logged only as structured minor-unit integers, not as user-facing decimals or raw payloads.
privacy_considerations: The trace stores only minimal identifiers and amount_cents in minor-unit form.
Full request bodies remain out of scope for default logging.
Log retention and centralized export workflows should be governed by the existing privacy policy.

anomaly_detection_behavior.trigger: An exact 100x or 1/100 relation with recent account transactions is detected.
anomaly_detection_behavior.mutation_policy: No automatic correction or rebalance mutation occurs.

audit_behavior.persisted_as: structured metadata with the audit log record

correlation_id_behavior.storage: persisted in audit metadata and logger output

status_note: The historical recovery case remains in FINAL_HOLD. The codebase improvements are preventive only and do not reopen the E.6 recovery loop.
